finalText:
**Redis died and nothing else recovered.**

`redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` at `02:14:07` in [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log#L182). Cache fell back to direct store reads.

Then 5000ms `TimeoutError` and cache miss storms, non stop. Queue depth grew 52 to 568, past `max 500`.

All 13 reconnect tries failed, last at `02:31:26`.

`worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, exit 134. `api` was killed at `02:31:52` — service down.

188 errors, 348 warns, 17 minutes.

Next: check why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connections.
